nusmp.skill.book_scale.description: A grimoire of Scale: the overlapping scales of fish, lizards and dragons. Beside the bolt, line, field, domain and guard it holds a volley of scales, a serpent, a shield, a suit of scale mail that forges itself on you piece by piece, and the Shedding Tide. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_volley: Scale Volley: throw five scales in a fan. Each hurts the first foe it meets (damage scales with EP) and weakens it.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_serpent: Scale Serpent: call a wyrm of scales that follows you, slithers to the nearest foe and bites it (Weakness, Slowness) for about 25 seconds. A mighty caster calls two.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_shield: Scale Shield: a kite shield of scales hovers in front of you for about 15 seconds and turns every projectile that flies at you back at its sender.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_mail: Scale Mail: a suit of teal scales forges itself on you for 20 seconds: a quarter of every blow is softened and a fifth more against projectiles, Resistance II.
nusmp.page.book_scale.scale_tide: Shedding Tide: shed your scales in a wave that hurts everything within six blocks and throws it back; you slough every harmful effect and heal a sixth of your health.
